sourceFile: 29. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test JIG SUB3 & Jig VP press improve check function 2025.12.15_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable source evidence but the changed-factor and comparison grouping are not reliable enough for final Ask AI use.
issues: Changed factor mixes baseline and test conditions incorrectly.
Date/test-round grouping is not preserved for Normal rows.
Comparisons cross different AWF and UV conditions without subgroup control.
Outcome measurement section appears to parse headers/data incorrectly.
Key cited row Test!23 is not shown in supplied context.
requiredUserQuestions: Should AWF and UV dry settings be subgroups or separate changed factors?
Is the primary claim improved jig versus normal jig within each date group?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as jig improvement or VP press jig test, not a combined condition list.
Group rows by merged date/test round and preserve machine, AWF, UV, and jig state.
Compare each test only against the relevant same-group Normal or normal semi sub3 condition.
Remove or recalc the measurement-stat outcome from actual data rows.
Cite header plus all data rows used, including decision row if used for conclusion.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are partly sufficient for existence but insufficient for validated grouping.
